android.desc:
PIKANINI– Smarter Food Decisions, Every Day

Still asking yourself “What should I eat?” every day?

Stop overthinking meals and start making smarter food decisions in seconds.

PIKANINI is your personal food decision companion designed to help you decide what to eat faster, smarter, and with less stress. Whether you want to cook, buy food, eat healthier, track calories, manage your food budget, or discover places to eat nearby — PIKANINI helps you make better food choices for your lifestyle.

No more wasting time deciding what to eat.

DECIDE WHAT TO EAT

Not sure what to eat?

PIKANINI helps you decide based on:

• Budget
• Mood & cravings
• Time available
• Energy level
• Ingredients at home
• Health goals
• Lifestyle preferences

PIKANINI helps you find the right meal for the moment.

COOK OR BUY?

Should you cook or buy food?

Compare:

• Cost of cooking vs buying
• Time required
• Convenience
• Effort needed

Make smarter food decisions before spending money.

FRIDGE SCAN

Got ingredients but no idea what to cook?

Simply scan your fridge, pantry, or ingredients and PIKANINIsuggests meals you can make instantly.

Reduce food waste, save money, and make the most of what you already have.

COOK SOMETHING

Already know you want to cook?

Get:

• Meal ideas
• Cooking inspiration
• Recipe guidance
• Ingredient swaps
• Quick meal suggestions

No endless scrolling through recipes you’ll never make.

RECIPE SEARCH

Know what you want to cook?

Search meals instantly and get cooking ideas, ingredient help, and preparation inspiration.

SCAN FOOD OR DRINK

Curious about a meal or drink?

Scan food or beverages to identify what you’re about to eat and learn more before deciding.

Perfect for restaurants, travel, discovering new meals, or trying something unfamiliar.

CALORIE & NUTRITION TRACKING

Trying to eat healthier?

Track:

• Calories
• Daily food intake
• Nutrition habits
• Health goals

Whether your goal is losing weight, gaining muscle, or simply eating better — PIKANINIhelps you stay mindful of your food choices.

TRACK FOOD SPENDING

Where does your food money go?

Track:

• Daily food expenses
• Weekly spending
• Monthly food costs
• Cooking vs buying habits

Understand spending patterns and make smarter food budget decisions.

Hungry and need food fast?
